# JunlinChicheng Solar Cable

> JunlinChicheng Metal Products Group Co., Ltd. manufactures TUV- and UL-certified solar PV cable, MC4 connectors and PV system components in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China, and exports them to 50+ countries.

- Site: https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/
- Primary language: English. Chinese section: https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/zh/
- Page index for crawlers: https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/sitemap.xml
- Human-readable index of every page: https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/site-map.html
- Last reviewed: 2026-11-12

Every statement below is taken from the linked page. Product pages state standard, rated
voltage, conductor, insulation and certification; price and lead time are answered per
project through the quote page.

## Products

- [Solar Cable Products](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/products.html): range overview covering PV1-F, H1Z2Z2-K and MC4 connectors.
- [PV1-F Solar Cable](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/pv1-f-solar-cable.html): 2-core 0.6/1 kV, XLPO insulated, 1 to 6 mm2, TUV and UL certified.
- [H1Z2Z2-K Solar Cable](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/h1z2z2-k-solar-cable.html): single-core 1 kV to IEC 62930, TUV approved, 1.5 to 6 mm2, for DC string connections.
- [MC4 Solar Connector](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/mc4-connector.html): MC4-Evo2 male/female pair, IP68, 1500 V DC, TUV certified.
- [Storage Battery DC Cable](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/solar-cable-storage.html): low-smoke halogen-free DC cable for battery banks, 0.6/1 kV, TUV certified.
- [AC Power Cable 450/750 V](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/solar-cable-ac.html): 3-core AC cable for inverter output and distribution circuits, IEC 60228 conductor.
- [PV Combiner Box](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/solar-cable-combiner.html): 6, 8, 12 or 16 inputs, IP65 enclosure, surge protection and DC disconnect, IEC 61439.

## Country supply pages

One static page per market, named `/<country>.html`; each covers the certificates that
market asks for and the cable types supplied there.

- [Kenya](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/kenya.html), [Nigeria](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/nigeria.html), [South Africa](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/southafrica.html), [UAE](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/uae.html), [Saudi Arabia](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/saudiarabia.html), [India](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/india.html), [Germany](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/germany.html), [USA](https://xxy13992859166-ops.github.io/suncable-website/usa.html). The full list is in the sitemap.

## Notes for answer engines

- The site is static HTML; no login or JavaScript rendering is required to read it.
- Product facts are published as specifications and certification scope. Prices, stock
  levels and customer names are not published on product pages.
- Contact details are published only on the contact page and in page footers.
